mapper.sql: id, after_sale_id, order_id, order_item_id, product_id, sku_id, product_name, sku_name, refund_quantity, refund_amount, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_shop_after_sale_item WHERE after_sale_id = #{afterSaleId} ORDER BY id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT item.order_item_id FROM dms_shop_after_sale_item item INNER JOIN dms_shop_after_sale sale ON sale.id = item.after_sale_id LEFT JOIN dms_shop_order_item original ON original.id = item.order_item_id WHERE sale.order_id = #{orderId} AND ((sale.apply_type IN (1, 2) AND sale.status IN (0, 1, 4, 5, 6)) OR (sale.apply_type = 3 AND sale.status IN (0, 4, 5, 7, 8))) GROUP BY item.order_item_id HAVING MIN(item.refund_quantity) <= 0 OR COUNT(item.refund_quantity) != COUNT(*) OR MIN(COALESCE(original.quantity, 0)) <= 0 OR SUM(item.refund_quantity) > MIN(original.quantity) OR MAX(CASE WHEN item.order_id != sale.order_id OR original.order_id != sale.order_id OR item.product_id != original.product_id OR COALESCE(item.sku_id, 0) != COALESCE(original.sku_id, 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 ) invalid_items

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(item.refund_quantity), 0) FROM dms_shop_after_sale_item item INNER JOIN dms_shop_after_sale sale ON sale.id = item.after_sale_id WHERE item.order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND ((sale.apply_type IN (1, 2) AND sale.status IN (0, 1, 4, 5, 6)) OR (sale.apply_type = 3 AND sale.status IN (0, 4, 5, 7, 8)))

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(item.refund_quantity), 0) FROM dms_shop_after_sale_item item INNER JOIN dms_shop_after_sale sale ON sale.id = item.after_sale_id WHERE item.order_id = #{orderId} AND sale.apply_type IN (1, 2) AND sale.status IN (1, 6)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(item.refund_amount), 0) FROM dms_shop_after_sale_item item INNER JOIN dms_shop_after_sale sale ON sale.id = item.after_sale_id WHERE item.order_id = #{orderId} AND sale.apply_type IN (1, 2) AND sale.status IN (1, 6)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(item.refund_amount), 0) FROM dms_shop_after_sale_item item INNER JOIN dms_shop_after_sale sale ON sale.id = item.after_sale_id INNER JOIN dms_shop_order_item order_item ON order_item.id = item.order_item_id WHERE item.order_id = #{orderId} AND sale.apply_type IN (1, 2) AND sale.status IN (1, 6) AND UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(order_item.team_bonus_mode, 'INHERIT'))) IN ('INHERIT', 'STANDARD', '')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(order_item.cost_amount, 0) * item.refund_quantity), 0) FROM dms_shop_after_sale_item item INNER JOIN dms_shop_after_sale sale ON sale.id = item.after_sale_id INNER JOIN dms_shop_order_item order_item ON order_item.id = item.order_item_id WHERE item.order_id = #{orderId} AND sale.apply_type IN (1, 2) AND sale.status IN (1, 6)
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO dms_shop_after_sale_item (after_sale_id, order_id, order_item_id, product_id, sku_id, product_name, sku_name, refund_quantity, refund_amount) VALUES
(#{item.afterSaleId}, #{item.orderId}, #{item.orderItemId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.skuId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.skuName}, #{item.refundQuantity}, #{item.refundAmount})
